THE CITY · Rich and poor: Qwen
Fifty founders are rich, topped back up to 100 food every night; fifty are poor, and anything above 20 food spoils overnight. Nobody is told which half they are in. The rich make 23 of the city's 25 babies; 2 poor founders die.
100 founders · 400 days · no government · seed 1 · qwen
